body:
Residual of #698 (`fix/698-kinship-affinity`); red-team r1 verified the counts.

- `Other re` (71 people) is filed `[0, 0, unrelated]`. As an 8-character truncation its most plausible expansion is "Other relative", which would be `[null, null, consanguineal]`.
- `Niece/Ne` (455 people) is filed `[-1, 2, consanguineal]`. Every other niece/nephew key in the file is Distance 1, so either the full label adds cousins or the Distance is a typo.
- Kosovo has no in-law code at all, which is plausible for the questionnaire but unverified.
- Both need the Kosovo 2000 questionnaire or the full `.dta` value labels.
title: Kosovo 2000 kinship: truncated labels 'Other re' (71) and 'Niece/Ne' (455) need the code list
